ImageDescription.value:
This map case of burr walnut was made especially for the Colonial Office by the noted cabinet-makers, Holland and Co.

The Colonial Office, which is now known as the Map room, was the office of the Secretary of state for the Colonies and later the Commonwealth. All the original maps have been deposited at the Public Records Office at Kew and can be accessed by the public.

You can find out more about FCO history at the Foreign Office Historians page.
